title: staging-e2e-run-record
description: Machine-readable record of one staging end-to-end run of two-bot-next: which revision was deployed, which deploy-staging run put it there, which commands were exercised with timings, per-command pass/fail, failure-signature references, tester identity, cleanup result and the QA verdict. Staging only; never production. Failure-signature IDs are opaque references into the separate failure-signature triage runbook, which this schema does not define.

schema_version.description: Version of this record format. Current version is 1.

mock.description: True only for worked examples. Real run records omit this field or set it to false.

id.description: Unique run label, for example staging-e2e-2026-10-04-001.

plan_ref.description: Human-readable pointer to the run plan or checklist rows covered (no secrets, no internal tracker IDs).

environment.description: Where the run executed. Staging only.

guild_id.description: Staging guild snowflake the fixture actions targeted.

deployment.description: What revision was under test and which deploy-staging run put it there.

revision.description: Exact deployed commit SHA under test (40 lowercase hex characters).

deploy_staging_run_id.description: GitHub Actions run ID of the deploy-staging workflow that deployed the revision (digits only).

worker_version.description: Worker version string reported by the staging deployment receipt, when known.

first_readyz_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the first /readyz 200 after this deployment (redeploy-gap measurement).

tester.description: Who ran the commands. A role, handle or agent name; never a token, secret or credential.

window.description: UTC window during which commands were exercised.

commands.description: One entry per command exercised, in execution order. At least one entry is required.

name.description: Command as invoked, for example /rank or !faq.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time from invocation to observed reply, in whole milliseconds.

expected.description: One line: what the fixture should have produced.

actual.description: One line: what was observed (sanitized, no message content, no IDs beyond fixture aliases).

failure_signature.description: Opaque ID into the failure-signature triage runbook. Required when result is fail; omit otherwise.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the redacted screenshot, log excerpt or CI receipt for this command.

cleanup.description: Fixture cleanup and rollback outcome after the run.

notes.description: What was restored through the normal UI/API, or what is still pending and who owns it.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what passed, what failed, and the next step.

follow_up_refs.description: Public references to follow-up work (public issue numbers or plain descriptions; no secrets).
